closure.cancelOption: Cancel Tasks to close the Campaign (optional)
closure.cancelHelp: Select only work that will not continue. Cancellation retains content and approval history and requires confirmation.
closure.title: Review Campaign completion
closure.description: Resolve received Requests and finish all Tasks. Cancelling Tasks retains content and approval history.
closure.pending: {{count}} pending Requests will be cancelled after Campaign completion.
closure.reviewingHelp: Open each Request to accept or deny. Accepted Requests create additional Tasks to resolve.
closure.confirmBatch: Confirm cancellation of {{count}} Tasks. Reason: {{reason}}. Content and approval history are retained.
closure.blocked: Completion blocked. Resolve outstanding items first.
closure.legacy: {{count}} legacy Request Tasks have no Campaign link. Review the data.

reasons.CLIENT_NO_LONGER_NEEDS: Client no longer needs the work
reasons.MUTUAL_AGREEMENT: Both parties agreed not to proceed
reasons.NO_LONGER_SUITABLE: No longer suitable for the Campaign

title: Campaign plan

partners.title: Campaign partners
partners.description: Manual cooperation tracking. Updating a partner does not change the approved Campaign plan or publish content automatically.
partners.empty: No partners linked to this Campaign.
partners.noCampaign: The Manager must create a Campaign before partners can be linked.
partners.noDirectory: The Agency partner directory is empty. Add partners through the E50-08 directory module when available.
partners.error: Unable to load or save partners. Please try again.
partners.conflict: Another user updated this partner. The list will reload; review the latest status before retrying.
partners.forbidden: You do not have permission to update Campaign partners.

packageRequired: Approve the package before planning a Campaign.
description: One Workspace runs one Campaign from its approved package. The Client gives feedback, the Manager edits, and both approve the same version before launch.
name: Campaign name
workItemsHint: Specific work grouped by deliverable; each work item becomes a Task when the Campaign is deployed. Adding work items does not increase the agreed package quantities.
error: Unable to load or save the plan. Check input and try again.

delivery.title: Deployment and progress
delivery.reasonHint: Resolve all unfinished Tasks and received Requests before completing the Campaign.

errors.CAMPAIGN_CLOSURE_BLOCKED: Resolve unfinished Tasks and received Requests before completing.
errors.CAMPAIGN_TASK_STATE_CONFLICT: Task state changed. Review the list and select again.
errors.TASK_SCHEMA_NOT_READY: Apply the MongoDB Campaign closure migration before cancellation.
errors.CAMPAIGN_ALREADY_EXISTS: A Campaign already exists. Cancel editing and reload.
errors.CAMPAIGN_VERSION_CONFLICT: Plan changed. Keep needed input, cancel editing and reload.
errors.CAMPAIGN_LEGACY_TERMS: This legacy package or plan has no frozen deliverable scope or still uses monthly quantities, so editing is locked pending data review. Monthly quantities are not converted automatically.
errors.CAMPAIGN_PLAN_INCOMPLETE: Add strategy, start/end dates and at least one work item before approval.
errors.CAMPAIGN_COMPLETION_REASON_REQUIRED: A reason is required while tasks remain unfinished.
errors.CAMPAIGN_DEPLOYMENT_INCOMPLETE: Not all tasks were created. Check deployment progress.
errors.CAMPAIGN_NOT_APPROVED: Both sides must approve the same Campaign version before deployment.

ui.editLocked: The approved plan is locked and its content cannot be edited. Only a Draft plan can be edited.
ui.emptyHint: The Manager creates one Campaign for this Workspace from the approved package. Saving a draft does not create Tasks or deploy it.
ui.totalQuantity: Scope and quantities are frozen from the approved package version.
ui.milestonesHint: Key Campaign dates, such as concept sign-off or launch. A milestone records only a name and date; it does not create a Task.
ui.approvalHint: Approval applies to the current version v{{version}}. A plan change requires both parties to approve again.
ui.historicalVersion: Viewing historical v{{version}}. The approval button above always applies to current v{{current}}.
ui.firstVersion: No previous version is available to compare.
